ui.app.name: BeHERE
ui.around.absent.catalogue: The Brussels regional catalogue covers the Brussels-Capital Region only.
ui.around.absent.heritage: The Flemish heritage register covers Flanders only. There is no equivalent point service in this region, so this layer is absent by design, not by error.
ui.around.absent.ods: No local open-data portal publishes a place dataset for this municipality.
ui.around.absent.wallonia: The Walloon tourism service covers Wallonia only, so this layer is absent by design, not by error.
ui.around.catalogue.lead: {n} regional datasets in the Brussels catalogue cover this location. Listed for discovery only: licence terms are not yet verified, so nothing here is rendered as fact.
ui.around.empty.catalogue: No regional dataset in the Brussels catalogue covers this location.
ui.around.empty.layer: No {cat} data published for this municipality.
ui.around.foreign: {n} addresses in this square belong to {name}, which is not in this release.
ui.around.loading.heritage: Loading. The Flemish heritage register takes about 20 seconds to answer, and everything else on this screen is already shown.
ui.around.nogeo: {title} publishes no map coordinates, so it cannot be placed on the ground.
ui.around.none: Nothing published within {r} m of here.
ui.around.noshards: The baked places for this square have not loaded yet.
ui.around.quota: The daily quota for {host} is nearly used up. Local datasets are paused until it resets.
ui.around.rendererror: This layer answered, but BeHERE could not display it.
ui.around.unavailable: {source} could not be reached. Nothing is shown for this layer.
ui.band.missing: The {band} band is not part of this build.
ui.empty.around.idle: Heritage, tourism, parks, markets, recycling and charging points appear here, sorted by real distance, once your position is known.
ui.empty.charging: No charging point data published for this municipality.
ui.empty.departures: No departure in the next hour.
ui.empty.event: No event data published for this municipality.
ui.empty.go.idle: The nearest stops of De Lijn, TEC, STIB-MIVB and NMBS-SNCB are stored on this device. Live departures need a network.
ui.empty.here.address: No baked address near this position. The seven pilot cities carry addresses; the ground between them does not.
ui.empty.here.idle: Waiting for your location. Nothing is sent anywhere: the addresses, neighbourhoods and municipalities of the seven pilot cities are already stored on this device.
ui.empty.here.municipality: This position is outside the municipalities in this release.
ui.empty.here.position: No position yet, so BeHERE cannot say where you are.
ui.empty.here.province: The Brussels-Capital Region has no province.
ui.empty.here.sector: No statistical sector could be resolved for this position.
ui.empty.here.streets: The street name table for this municipality has not loaded, so the street is shown by its id.
ui.empty.heritage: No heritage data published for this municipality.
ui.empty.local: No local dataset published for this municipality.
ui.empty.market: No market data published for this municipality.
ui.empty.now.idle: What is open, collected or happening today, once your position is known.
ui.empty.park: No park data published for this municipality.
ui.empty.playground: No playground data published for this municipality.
ui.empty.recycling: No recycling data published for this municipality.
ui.empty.sources: The source list loads with the data manifest.
ui.empty.stats: No statistics published at this level.
ui.empty.stops: No stop from any of the four operators falls in this square.
ui.empty.tourism: No tourism data published for this municipality.
ui.empty.zoom.municipality: This position is outside the municipalities in this release, so no arrondissement can be named.
ui.empty.zoom.novalues: Statbel answered for this arrondissement but published none of the figures this band shows.
ui.empty.zoom.nuts3: This municipality record carries no arrondissement code, so Statbel cannot be queried for it.
ui.empty.zoom.offline: Statbel statistics need a network and nothing has been stored for this arrondissement yet.
ui.empty.zoom.position: Zoom-out context appears once your position is known.
ui.empty.zoom.unreachable: Statbel could not be reached, and nothing from it is stored on this device yet.
ui.empty.zoomout.idle: Context for the arrondissement and for Belgium appears here. It is context, never a ranking.
ui.fail.layer: {layer} unavailable. Showing what was last fetched, on {date}.
ui.fail.live: Live departures unavailable. Showing the timetable, last updated {date}.
ui.fail.offline: You are offline. Showing the data baked on {date}.
ui.flag.aggregate: This figure crosses a 2025 municipal merger, so it is an aggregate.
ui.flag.endonym: Street and place names are shown in their official local language.
ui.flag.endonym_adopted: Reviewed: English uses the local name.
ui.fm.note: {n} addresses in this square are in {name}, which is not in this release.
ui.geo.prov.none: No province. The Brussels-Capital Region belongs to none.
ui.go.asof: Live departures unavailable. Showing the last board seen, as of {when}.
ui.go.nodepartures: No departures in the next hour.
ui.go.nostops: No stop of De Lijn, TEC, STIB-MIVB or NMBS-SNCB is recorded within about a kilometre of here. The stop index is baked from the national access point, vintage 2025-01-01.
ui.go.rt.none: {op} does not publish realtime departures on the NAP. This stop is served, but no live times exist.
ui.go.rt.operator.none: {op} publishes no realtime feed on the national access point, so no live times are shown for its stops.
ui.go.rt.savedata: Live departures skipped to save data. The {op} feed is {mb} MB.
ui.go.rt.unavailable: Live departures unavailable. The stop itself is stored on this device.
ui.go.src.irail: Train times from iRail. A browser cannot send a custom User-Agent, so this client identifies in a query parameter and stays under 3 requests per second.
ui.go.stops.label: Nearest stops
ui.here.coverage.intro: This square also holds addresses in municipalities this release does not ship, so they are named here rather than silently dropped.
ui.here.denied: Location is switched off for this page. Turn it on to answer “where am I”.
ui.here.far: The nearest baked address is {d} away, so this is approximate.
ui.here.local: Every line above was read from data already on this device.
ui.here.manual: Position set by hand, not by the device.
ui.here.outside: You are outside the seven municipalities in this release.
ui.here.postcodes.note: {name} spans {n} postcodes. A postcode names a delivery area, not a municipality, so BeHERE never resolves your position through one.
ui.here.postcodes.note.one: One postcode here. A postcode still names a delivery area, not a municipality.
ui.here.sector.polygon: the polygon you are standing in, simplified to {t} m
ui.here.unavailable: Your device did not return a position.
ui.install.ios: To install BeHERE on this iPhone or iPad: Share, then Add to Home Screen.
ui.lang.label: Language
ui.lang.note: Set from the municipality you are in. Your choice is remembered on this device.
ui.now.asof: Shown from what was stored, as of {when}.
ui.now.collection.empty: No collection at this address in the next eight days.
ui.now.collection.noaddress: The collection calendar is per street. It appears once your address is known.
ui.now.collection.none: {city} does not publish a waste collection calendar as open data.
ui.now.event.empty: Nothing dated for today or this weekend.
ui.now.event.none: No event calendar is published as open data for {city}.
ui.now.market.unparsed: {n} more market records list no usable opening hours and are not shown.
ui.now.ratelimit: The portal's daily request budget is nearly used up, so this was not refreshed.
ui.now.src.rules: Opening hours, market days and collection dates are evaluated on this device, so this band works offline.
ui.now.unreachable: This calendar could not be reached, and nothing from it is stored on this device yet.
ui.offline.bar: You are offline. Everything below comes from what is stored on this device.
ui.offline.none: No baked data is stored on this device yet, so Here needs a network for now.
ui.offline.stored: Stored on this device: all {total} data files of {cities} cities. Here, and the baked part of Around and Go, answer with no network.
ui.offline.storing: Storing the {cities} cities for offline use: {stored} of {total} files so far.
ui.source.label: Source
ui.zoom.context: Context for the arrondissement you are standing in, and for Belgium. BeHERE does not rank municipalities.
ui.zoom.dependency.note: people of 65 and over per person of working age
ui.zoom.stale: Statbel could not be reached. These are the last figures stored on this device.
